component.name: DocSuite Device Center
component.summary: Native Linux printing, scanning, OCR and device diagnostics

description.p: DocSuite Device Center provides standards-first printer and scanner management for Linux using IPP/CUPS, SANE and direct eSCL backends.

It includes physical device capability and status discovery, dynamic print controls, scan preview and document processing, OCR, searchable PDF export, multipage document sessions, copy workflows, job diagnostics and a local per-user device service.
Development milestone with IPP printing, SANE/eSCL scanning, OCR, document processing, diagnostics and Debian packaging.
